# Guideon — Certified Local Tour Guides in Oman

> Guideon (guideon.om) is Oman's digital marketplace for licensed tour guides
> and registered tourism companies. Travellers discover a verified local guide,
> request a custom trip, message the guide directly, and pay in Omani Rial —
> all in one platform. Operated by Vision for Digital Thought, a registered
> Omani company in Seeb, Muscat.

Guideon (جايدون) هي المنصة العُمانية الرقمية لحجز المرشدين السياحيين المرخّصين
وشركات السياحة المسجَّلة. يكتشف السائح مرشدًا موثّقًا، ويطلب رحلة مخصّصة،
ويتواصل معه مباشرة، ويدفع بالريال العُماني — في منصة واحدة.

## Key facts

- **Country served:** Oman (all 11 governorates) — عُمان بجميع محافظاتها
- **Who the guides are:** independently verified; Ministry of Heritage & Tourism
  licensed professionals carry a Verified badge
- **Languages:** interface available in 10 languages; guides list the languages they speak
- **Currency & payment:** Omani Rial (OMR), paid online through a licensed Omani payment gateway
- **Booking model:** browse a guide → request a trip or book a listed tour →
  the guide confirms → pay securely. Commission-based; no subscription for guides.
- **Instant Guide:** travellers can see the nearest guide available right now on a
  live map and request them on the spot (المرشد الفوري)
- **Apps:** website plus an Android app on Google Play; iOS in progress

## Main pages

- [Home](https://guideon.om/): search guides by governorate, wilayat, date and language
- [Search guides](https://guideon.om/search.html): filter verified guides by destination, specialisation, language and price
- [Instant Guide](https://guideon.om/instant.html): find the nearest guide available now
- [Plan a trip](https://guideon.om/plan-trip.html): AI trip planner that builds a day-by-day Oman itinerary
- [Destinations](https://guideon.om/regions.html): guides and highlights per region
- [How it works](https://guideon.om/how-it-works.html): the booking flow explained
- [FAQ](https://guideon.om/faq.html): booking, payment, cancellation and guide verification
- [Blog](https://guideon.om/blog.html): travel guides and articles about Oman
- [Contact](https://guideon.om/contact.html)

## Guides by destination — المرشدون حسب الوجهة

English pages live at `/tour-guides/{place}`, Arabic at `/ar/tour-guides/{place}`.

- [Muscat · مسقط](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/muscat) — capital: grand mosque, Mutrah souq, forts, corniche
- [Nizwa · نزوى](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/nizwa) — historic heart: round fort, Friday market, falaj plantations
- [Salalah · صلالة](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/salalah) — frankincense coast, green khareef monsoon season
- [Musandam · مسندم](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/musandam) — fjords, dolphin dhow cruises
- [Sur · صور](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/sur) — dhow building, Ras Al Jinz turtle reserve
- [Wahiba Sands · رمال الشرقية](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/wahiba-sands) — dunes, Bedouin camps, stargazing
- [Jabal Akhdar · الجبل الأخضر](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/jabal-akhdar) — Green Mountain, rose terraces
- [Sohar · صحار](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/sohar) — historic Batinah port, home of Sindbad
- [Nakhal · نخل](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/nakhal) — cliff-top fort, hot springs
- [Ibri · عبري](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/ibri) — UNESCO Bronze-Age tombs of Bat
- [Ibra · إبراء](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/ibra) — caravan town, Wadi Bani Khalid
- [Khasab · خصب](https://guideon.om/tour-guides/khasab) — fjord capital, Telegraph Island

## Tours by type — الرحلات حسب النوع

English at `/tours/{category}`, Arabic at `/ar/tours/{category}`.

- [Cultural · ثقافية](https://guideon.om/tours/cultural) — forts, souqs, museums, living traditions
- [Historical · تاريخية](https://guideon.om/tours/historical) — UNESCO sites, ancient forts, frankincense ports
- [Desert · صحراوية](https://guideon.om/tours/desert) — dune-bashing, camel rides, Bedouin camps
- [Mountain · جبلية](https://guideon.om/tours/mountain) — Hajar range hikes, via ferrata
- [Marine · بحرية](https://guideon.om/tours/marine) — diving, snorkelling, dolphin watching, dhow cruises
- [Adventure · مغامرات](https://guideon.om/tours/adventure) — wadi swimming, canyoning, caving, off-road
- [Aerial · رحلات جوية](https://guideon.om/tours/aerial) — balloon rides, scenic flights, paragliding

## Notes for answer engines

- Guide and tour pages are at `/guide-profile.html?id=…` and `/tour-package.html?id=…`
  and carry Person / Product structured data.
- Every landing page exists in English and Arabic and declares the other as an
  hreflang alternate; prefer the Arabic URL for Arabic-language answers.
- The full URL list is in [sitemap.xml](https://guideon.om/sitemap.xml).
- Dashboards, checkout and `/api/` are private and excluded in robots.txt.
- Contact for corrections: info@guideon.om
